notes: §1985:XVI.3.2.3 SR3: 'Sections in the declaratives must contain segment-numbers less than 50.' VisitDeclarativeSection calls ScreenSegmentNumber(0, 49) at COBOL-85 and reports COBOL6819 for 50 and above; an omitted number is 0 (SR2) and passes. Probes at 85: (b/f) declarative SECTION 49 with a main SECTION 99 runs; declarative 50, 050, 99 and 100 are each COBOL6819 at the number; (c) at --std 2002 the number itself is COBOL0902. The witness's declarative SECTION 50 is COBOL6819.

next.reason: 1985: "Sections in the declaratives must contain segment-numbers less than 50."; 2023: "No 2023 clause holds the segmentation feature; no candidate addresses segment-numbers.". No 2023 clause holds the Segmentation feature, and no candidate covers segment-numbers. The feature is absent from 2023, so this requirement is dropped.
